blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: Suspended ceilings are modular (600×600mm, 600×1200mm). NRC for offices is 0.75+; for retail, 0.65. Class A fire rating is material property; 2-hour fire rating requires assembly design. Seismic zones need diagonal bracing—it's not optional.</Tip>
